description: CI eval questions for the fixture library (library.json). Same format as ../questions.json: 'expected' are title substrings, [] means not covered; 'passage' (long-page cases) is text the answering chunk must contain; 'expected_answer' lists substrings, one of which the instant answer must quote (answer hit). Questions are worded unlike the saves on purpose.
